  Pursuant to State and County Directives, the physical access to the meeting has been
  suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an opportunity to
  comment on items on this Agenda, the following opportunity has been established:

  Public Comments

  Please email all public comments on items on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and
  include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 12/21/2021

  three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity,
  and discriminatory language, will not be read.

  Watch the Meeting Online

MINUTES OF DECEMBER 21 , 2021
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Li ao called the special virtual meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  5:30 P.M. on Tuesday, December 21, 2021 .

  ROLL CALL
  Council Members Present:  John R. Harrington, Denise Menchaca, Jason Pu, Vice
  Mayor Tony Ding, and Mayor Chin Ho Liao.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux, Community Services Director Rebecca Perez,
  Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark, Human Resources/Risk
  Management Director Edward Macias, Labor Relations
  Counsel Steve Filarsky, and Assistant City Clerk Marilyn
  Bonus.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

I  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
  submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas.

  1. OPEN SESSION

  A. DISCUSS THE POTENTIAL CANCELLATION OF THE 2022 SAN GABRIEL LUNAR
  NEW YEAR FESTIVAL DUE TO COVID-19 CONCERNS

  City Manager Lazzaretto made the presentation.

  There was no public comment.

  Di scussion included increasing cases of COVI D-19 posing a health risk in large
  gatherings; actions neighboring cities have taken in relation to Lunar New Year
  events; costs incurred by th e City to date; having controlled entry points for a
  street-closure event; possible alternative formats such as an indoor event in the
  Mission Playhouse with masks and checks of vaccinati on status; financial impacts

I  of waiting longer to make a decision about holding the event; and leaving the
  decision up to the subcommittee of Community Services Director Perez and
  Council Member Pu .

  Th ere was a consensus of the City Council to cancel th e outdoor event, and direct
  the subcommittee to consid er an indoor event at the Mission Playhouse with the
  discretion to make decisions on the alternate programming for the event.

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

  There was no reportable action .

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:14 P.M .
